question: Cuantas victorias tiene Lewis Hamilton en la Formula 1?

question: Cual fue el promedio de puntos por carrera de Lewis Hamilton en 2015?

question: Que escuderia logro mas victorias en la temporada 2015?

question: Cuales fueron los campeones del 2015?

expectation.reference_sql: SELECT r.year AS season_year, 'Driver' AS category, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS champion_name, ds.points AS total_points, ds.wins AS total_wins FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id WHERE r.year = 2015 AND r.round = (SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE year = 2015) AND ds.position = 1 UNION ALL SELECT r2.year AS season_year, 'Constructor' AS category, c.name AS champion_name, cs.points AS total_points, cs.wins AS total_wins FROM constructor_standings cs JOIN races r2 ON cs.race_id = r2.race_id JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id WHERE r2.year = 2015 AND r2.round = (SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE year = 2015) AND cs.position = 1 ORDER BY category
